xBRIEFInfo.description: Admit dest-worktree mints at spawn and allow multi-story mint into one checkout.

narratives.Overview: Spawn must read the dest worktree mint when cwd is that worktree. Manifest may mint several stories into one checkout.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator running overnight YOLO bulk mint into dest worktrees, I need spawn_subagent to admit a dest-cwd mint and scope:record-approved-scope --manifest to write several planId records into one checkout, so builders start without a second mint pass.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) In dispatcher spawn admission, when cwd is a linked worktree of the project, use that worktree as the onePrMint / active-scope fence root. 2) In scope-record-approved-scope-cohort, allow several distinct planId records to share one worktree_path. 3) Tests for dest-only admit and multi-planId shared checkout. 4) changelog.d fragment.

items.title: When spawn_subagent cwd is a linked worktree of the project, active-scope and one-PR mint admission use that worktree as the fence root so a dest mint admits the spawn.
scope:record-approved-scope --manifest may write several distinct planId records into one worktree in one typed mint; plan ids stay unique.
